podcast.body: An even funkier jam than "Machine Gun," this song was written by guitarist Thomas McClary and became a number 1 R&B hit, cracking the pop Top 20. Lionel Richie served as the lead singer on this track. "The following year, Slippery When Wet and even Funkier Jam, written by Commodores guitarist Thomas McClarry, went to number one R&B and cracked the pop top 20."
